heading.en: Linking nage-waza, applied in the same direction

prose.en: Tori applies o-uchi-gari, and applies o-soto-gari at the point where uke steps back to defend.
Uke defends against tori's o-uchi-gari by stepping backwards.
Uke takes an ushiro-ukemi (rear breakfall) in time with the o-soto-gari.

５　技の連絡変化
⑴　投げ技の連絡
